summary: The change adds a co-applicant tax identifier to applicant data and to scheduled disposal, but leaves it out of the NPI registry that defines sealed fields. ENC-1 requires tax identifiers to be persisted only in sealed form, and the retention special-case plus the passing store test that keeps non-NPI fields readable show this value stays readable. Change-ticket, independent approval, control-owner approval, and the head-commit test run are in order, and retention still honors legal hold, but that does not cure the unsealed tax id. The change is rejected.
